feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 11:30pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 14 November 2026 at 11:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Cloudy with only isolated showers early tonight. Fresh to strong south or southwest winds.

Comments: Strong winds.

A band of rain will arrive overnight, remaining persistent and heavy at times through the morning. This will gradually clear during the afternoon, though a few showers may linger. Fresh to strong, southwest winds will decrease for a time in the morning before veering northwest and strengthening again. Maximum temperature 10°C.


##Outlook##

Some clear intervals and a few showers overnight, which may be wintry over higher ground. Minimum temperature of -1°C on higher ground and in the central valley.

Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens through the evening with a band of rain arriving early in the night. Moderate to fresh northwest winds becoming light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Sunrise##

7:45am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

4:19pm Tomorrow
